evidence.reason: In run_case, mutated_files is captured after mutate(), but after the CLI runs the code captures only records, completions, and units before calling cleanup(). For the unsafe-metadata case cleanup() restores the original mode, so a controller that chmods the drop-in to 0600 and then returns the expected refusal leaves no visible difference by the later baseline file comparison. That false-passes the negative control. Capture repair_files() immediately after the CLI call and compare it with mutated_files before cleanup; use finally for cleanup.
